about: A capsule runs where the regions a place's own lock offers, region/<name> measure=leaves with the leaves each holds, meet by name the reader regions of a capsule the instrument carries: declaration against declaration, never a capsule's reads against a place's leaves.

What a place's regions meet that its lock does not pin is proposed as the pin, <place>/uses/<package> at the capsule's digest. A reader line of the tree leaves when what places offer reaches everything it reaches, once its capsule has read there; more is what the places declared. One that reaches what no place offers is owed: the places offer it, or it leaves by a withdrawal its owner signs with a witness.
